transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well... I guess I'm here because I just feel like I'm always moving from one thing to the next. I can't really... idle, I guess. And, um, there's a new setup at work recently, and it's just made that a lot harder to hide. So... yeah. That's about it.
Do you often act on impulse without thinking things through?
Not really. I mean... I don't think so. I usually know what I'm doing before I do it. I wouldn't say I just... jump into things blind, if that's what you mean.
Do you often feel restless or fidgety?
I suppose. I mean... I try to look calm, but my foot is usually bouncing under the desk. Or I'll be... clicking a pen during a meeting and not really notice I'm doing it. Just small things like that.
Do you have difficulty paying attention to details or making careless mistakes?

Yeah, I guess. Um... mostly at work. I'll think I've finished a customer ticket, and then... well, later I'll notice I typed the wrong account number. Or maybe I skipped a required box. Just... missing one little instruction, and the whole thing comes back to me. So... yeah. It happens.
Do you experience restlessness or fidgeting at home or in social situations, not just at work?

Yeah, I suppose so. Um... even with quiet stuff. Like, if I'm trying to read at home or... sitting through a movie with my wife. I don't really last long before I'm... shifting around, or making comments. Or I just get up to find something to do. So... yeah, it's not just at work.
Have you always felt this way, even when you were a kid?

I guess so. Um... yeah, it's been a long time. Even before I started this job. I remember... well, my parents used to show me my old report cards from grade school. The teachers would always write the same sort of things. That I was a bright kid, but... careless. Or that I talked out of turn a lot. They were always having to remind me to just... stay on task and finish my work. So... yeah, I suppose it's always been there.
Did you have more energy than your siblings or friends when you were a kid?
I don't really know. Um... maybe? I mean, I guess kids usually have a lot of energy. I don't remember paying much attention to how I compared to my friends or anything back then. So... I'm not sure.
Have you ever had trouble waiting for your turn in conversations or interrupted others while they were speaking?

Um... sometimes, I guess. I don't mean to be rude or anything. But... like at work, if I hear my coworkers trying to figure out a customer problem... I'll usually just jump in with the answer. Even if they aren't finished talking, or... before anyone actually asks me. So... yeah, that happens.
As a child, did you often run, climb, or play more vigorously than your peers?
I don't really remember. It's been a long time since I was a kid. I was just... a kid playing, I guess. I couldn't tell you if I ran around more than anyone else.
Do you experience these restless or fidgety feelings in all aspects of your life, including when you're alone?
I haven't really noticed. Um... when I'm by myself, I'm usually just at home. I don't really pay attention to whether I'm fidgeting or not. So... I'm not sure.
Have you experienced these symptoms consistently throughout your adult life as well?

Yeah, I suppose so. I mean... looking back, it's been around long before I started this job. Even in grade school, I remember... well, my teachers used to write on my report cards that I was bright but... careless. They said I talked out of turn a lot. And they always had to remind me to just stay with my work. So... it's just always been there, I guess.
Have these symptoms caused you significant distress or problems in your daily life?

I suppose... maybe a little. Mostly at work, I guess. Um... it's started showing up in my reviews lately. My supervisors keep pointing out... well, unfinished tickets. And some mistakes. They say it slows the team down. I mean, I'm trying hard, and... I get along fine with the customers. But yeah... I guess it causes some issues there.
Have these symptoms caused problems in your relationships with family or friends?
Um... no, I don't think so. Things are mostly fine. I kind of just... keep to myself a lot outside of work anyway, so... no, no real problems there.
Have you ever been in a situation where your restlessness or fidgeting caused you to have trouble getting along with someone?
Um... no. Not really. I mean... I don't think anyone's ever gotten upset with me over something like that. Like I said, I mostly just keep to myself anyway, so... no. Not that I can think of.
Have these symptoms ever caused you to lose a job or significantly impact your career advancement?
Um... no. I haven't ever been fired. I've been doing customer service for a long time, so... there isn't really much moving up to worry about anyway. It's just the same job. So... no.
Have these symptoms interfered with your ability to perform daily tasks or activities outside of work?
Um... not really. I mean, I just kind of do what I need to do around the house and... that's about it. Nothing really gets in the way. It's just normal day-to-day stuff, so... no. I get by fine.
Have you ever felt like your symptoms have held you back from achieving your full potential at work or in your personal life?

Um... I don't really know about "full potential." I mean... I guess at work, it's been coming up a little lately in my reviews. My supervisors... they pointed out some unfinished tickets. And a few mistakes. They said it kind of slows the team down, which... I mean, I'm trying hard. And I get along with the customers just fine, so... I don't know. It's just some issues with the tickets, I guess. So... maybe a little.
Would you say that your symptoms are currently causing you more than minor problems in your daily life?

Um... I don't know if I'd say more than minor. Like I just said, it's really just the work stuff. The reviews with my supervisors... they bring up the unfinished tickets. And the mistakes. They say it slows the team down, but... I am trying. And the customers like me. So... it's just that, really. Nothing major.
Do you think your symptoms are severe enough to interfere with your overall functioning in life?

Um... I don't think it's that severe. I mean, overall functioning? No. Like I keep saying... it's just the work reviews. The supervisors talking about the tickets I didn't finish. Or the mistakes. They say it slows things down, but... I do my best. And the customers are happy with me. So... it doesn't ruin my whole life or anything. Just work.
Would you describe your symptoms as mild?
Yeah... I guess so. Mild sounds about right. It's... yeah, just what I said before. Nothing major.
